name: 08_fps_to_score.png
title: FPS vs score
caption: Target FPS to required score across 17,265 games (1080p High); the band is the middle 80% and the dotted line is the best card available. 1440p/4K scale the requirement by 1.54x/2.83x.
explanation: How much benchmark score each frame-rate target needs. Every faint line is one game; the band holds the middle 80% of them. Read up from your FPS target to see the score a GPU must beat.

name: 03_fps_curve.png
title: FPS curve
caption: Error per left-out card and error on unseen cards; the curve beats the random forest 13.3 vs 49.0 fps.
explanation: How well the FPS model generalises: each bar hides one reference GPU from the fit and predicts it back. The right panel compares the curve with a random forest on cards neither has seen.

name: 05_clusters.png
title: Demand levels
caption: Number of levels chosen by BIC (3 seeds per k) and how the level mix shifts over time.
explanation: Games grouped by hardware demand. Panel 1 shows how the number of groups was chosen, panel 2 the groups themselves, panel 3 how the mix of groups changes with release era.

name: 07_demand_trend.png
title: Demand trend
caption: Median minimum and recommended GPU score per period, plus the shift in game mix.
explanation: How hardware demand grew: median minimum and recommended GPU score per 5-year era, and the share of games an integrated GPU can run, that hit the frame cap, or that need a high-tier card.

name: 02_models.png
title: Tier models
caption: Random forest is selected (R2 0.89, RMSE 1,372) against a mean baseline of 4,219.
explanation: Which model predicts the required score best. The random forest (selected) is compared with three alternatives on error, fit quality and the features it relies on.

name: 01_data_quality_and_demand.png
title: Data quality and demand
caption: Column coverage and games by score range (n=17,194).
explanation: What the source data actually contains: how much of each column is missing, and how the games spread across performance needs.

name: 04_gpu_catalog.png
title: GPU catalog
caption: Benchmark spread for desktop, laptop and integrated GPUs; classifier accuracy 0.67.
explanation: The GPU catalogue the recommender picks from: benchmark score spread for desktop, laptop and integrated cards.

name: 06_rules.png
title: Association rules
caption: Top rules by lift with confidence; lift 16 means the specs make the tier 16x more likely than chance.
explanation: Which hardware requirements travel together. Each bar is a rule such as "6-8 GB VRAM, no frame cap, recent release -> high tier", ranked by how much better than chance it predicts.
